policy.selection: The published main uses absoluteClosest: smallest eligible final alliance-score margin across all phases, with playoffs preferred on equal margins. The preserved selected field is the closest playoff, or the closest qualification if no playoff exists; it supplies a separate playoff alternative when different. Both wins and losses qualify.
policy.scope: Official FIRST 2026 season schedules through 2026-06-12; later offseason appearances excluded.
policy.ties: Played ties with final numeric scores remain valid. No published FRC minimum-margin selection is a tied score or required a tie-break.
policy.tieBreak: Equal margins prefer playoffs, then later event end date, then a final, then event code and match number. No published FRC minimum required a tie-break.
policy.allianceContext: These are three-robot alliance scores, not an individual team score or proof of a season-long rivalry. Opponents/partners change.
